# INSANE's MASM 6.13 objects (docs/crt.md, "MASM 6.13"): DWORD-aligned .text sections (MASM's flat-model _TEXT), LINK's
# 0xCC fill between code contributions; a pad that only the next object's 16-byte alignment explains is that object's lead.
# MixerAsm.asm: eight mixer buffer procs, unaligned entries 0x004EC560..0x004EC6DD, one 0xCC to 0x004EC720 (its
# own alignment); its USE16 segment is the PE section _TEXT16 (4 bytes; the rest of the 0x200 raw block is file padding).
Libs/smush/insane/Sound/MixerAsm.asm:
# pe: {"bounds": "reviewed", "padding": "0xCC"}
    .text    start:0x004EC490 end:0x004EC650 align:4
# pe: {"bounds": "reviewed"}
    _TEXT16  start:0x00505000 end:0x00505004 align:16

# push ebp; mov ebp,esp; push es frames, unaligned entries, its data the words 0x0054DC70-0x0054DCA8) runs to
# 0x004EE6A0; 0x004EE6A0 starts the decode object, whose RLE functions use decode's .bss (insane.md, 2026-10-01).

    .text    start:0x0041C9E0 end:0x0041FB20 align:16

# formats became local aggregates and stdColor.h left the include list, this
# object's .rdata is the two 576-byte level-load-info arrays followed by a
# 44-byte pooled-constant run that is byte-identical to retail's
# 0x00506AE8-0x00506B0F (127.0f + pad, the doubles 1/480 and 0.5, 1.0f, 0.0f,
# and the double 1000.0). 100.0f at 0x00506B10 and the second 1.0f at 0x00506B14 are
# JonesDevDialog.obj's own pool (lane p2-rdstd 2026-09-23).
# pe: {"bounds": "reviewed"}
    .rdata   start:0x00506668 end:0x00506B10 align:8
# The 68 level-name/filename/mat literals the two JonesLevelInfo tables point at,
# claimed in the lane B session from the tables' own retail pointers. They form one
# contiguous 4-aligned run immediately after JonesMain_aErrorBuffer, and every one is
